newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bullish Oslo bourse hits another peak.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Oslo bourse hits another peak.

text.p: Norwegian shares moved higher to another record close on Thursday on the back of low interest rates and bullish market sentiment in general, dealers said.
The Oslo Bourse's Total index, which rose above the 1,000-point level on Wednesday for the first time, closed 0.23 percent up at 1,008.49 points. Turnover was heavy at 1.33 billion crowns.
"Investors are afraid to be under-weighted on the stock market," one dealer said.
Saga Petroleum jumped 3.73 percent to 125 crowns after the Oil Directorate reported that the oil company had made a new gas/condensate find in a block in the Norwegian Sea.
Some news reports said the find was among the biggest ever made in the area, but a Saga spokesman said it was not known how big the reservoir was.
Norsk Hydro was up marginally at 357 crowns.
